description: The rest of Studio's per-character state panel: skin gloss, wetness, the flat single-colour silhouette and its colour, the male part and its length, plus the two female-only settings (nipple stand and body fluids). Partial and absolute. The face sliders of that same panel — tears and blush — live in studio_set_character_expression instead. Read back from 'state' in studio_list_characters. Not undoable from Studio, and it leaves the undo stack usable.

nipple.description: nipple stand rate; **female only**, refused on a male because Studio's setter does nothing there. Studio's slider covers 0..1 and nothing clamps it in code, so a value outside that is stored and applied as-is

skin_gloss.description: skin glossiness; clamped to 0..1 by Studio

wet.description: wet look; clamped to 0..1 by Studio

simple.description: draw the character as a flat single-colour silhouette instead of its body

simple_color.description: colour of that silhouette, [r,g,b] or [r,g,b,a] in 0..1; can be set while 'simple' is off

son.description: show the male part; Studio offers this on both sexes

son_length.description: its length, 1 = default. Not clamped anywhere in Studio

siru.description: body fluids per area, 0 = none, 1 and 2 = increasing. **Female only** — the applier returns immediately on a male. Levels above 2 are refused: they index a three-entry table inside Studio's own update loop a frame later, where an out-of-range value takes the process down rather than erroring here

output.description: the character, same shape as one entry of studio_list_characters — read back 'state' to confirm
